ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Florian has 10 equally long metal strips with equally many holes. He bolts the metal strips together in pairs. Now he has five long strips (see the diagram). Which labeled long strip is the shortest?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper part shows 10 identical perforated metal strips, each with the same length, the same number of holes, and the same hole spacing. The lower part shows 5 long strips made by overlapping two metal strips and fastening them with bolts, labeled A, B, C, D, and E respectively. In each long strip, the two original metal strips have an overlapping region, and the bolts pass through the holes at the overlap. Reasoning: After two strips of the same length are overlapped, the total length equals the sum of the lengths of the two strips minus the overlap length; therefore, the more they overlap, the shorter the combined long strip is. Observing the overlap situations of A–E, in B the two strips overlap the most hole spacings in the middle, and the parts exposed toward the two ends are the least; in the other A, C, D, and E, the two bolts are relatively close together, and the overlap section is shorter. So B has the shortest total length.

raw_record.question_text: Florian has 10 equally long metal strips with equally many holes. He bolts the metal strips together in pairs. Now he has five long strips (see the diagram). Which labeled long strip is the shortest?

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: the top row shows 10 identical perforated metal strips; the lower diagram shows five paired strips labeled A–E, each made from two overlapping identical strips joined by bolts. From the text, use that all original strips are equally long and have the same equally spaced holes. For each labeled pair, count along the line of the strip how many hole-spacings are covered twice in the overlap, or equivalently count how many hole-spacings run from one outer rounded end of the combined strip to the other. The pair with the greatest overlap has the smallest total length because combined length = length of two strips minus the overlap. In the diagram, B has the largest overlap / fewest total exposed hole intervals, so B is shortest.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：上半部分显示10根相同的带孔金属条，每根长度相同、孔数相同、孔距相同。下半部分显示5个由两根金属条搭接后用螺栓固定的长条，分别标为A、B、C、D、E。每个长条中，两根原始金属条都有一段重叠区域，螺栓穿过重叠处的孔。推理：两根相同长度的条搭接后，总长度等于两根条的长度之和减去重叠长度；因此重叠越多，组合后的长条越短。观察A–E的重叠情况，B中两根条在中间重叠的孔距最多，外露到两端的部分最少；其他A、C、D、E的两个螺栓距离较近，重叠段较短。所以B的总长度最短。

method.method_draft: Describe the image first: the lower diagram shows five finished long strips A–E drawn at the same scale but at different orientations. From the text, understand that each long strip is formed from two identical metal strips, so the only thing to compare is the distance between the two farthest outside ends after bolting. For each label, ignore the angle of the drawing and mentally place a straight measuring line along the centerline of the combined strip from one rounded outer end to the other. Compare these end-to-end spans directly in the image: A, C, D, and E extend farther between their two outside ends, while B has the smallest end-to-end span. Therefore the shortest labeled long strip is B.
